source: known difference: docx-agent's insert_control takes the position unchecked and fails inside new_run with Python's IndexError ('list index out of range', not_found); the Rust core refuses the position, saying how many characters the paragraph has (as word_notes refuses one). A docx-agent crash, not copied.

known difference: P4c10: docx-agent makes the new wp:anchor or wp:inline detached, so lxml names its namespace ns0 (and wp14 ns1) and the frame's children ns0:...; the Rust core keeps the frame's own declarations of wp and wp14 on the new frame, so it and its children keep wp:. Both are the same XML; Word reads either.
